caption: The drawing shows a symmetrical object centered on a plain, beige background. The object is primarily circular and resembles a medallion or decorative shield, rendered in grayscale with shading that suggests a metallic surface. Radiating from the central round area are eight extensions: four of them, spaced evenly, are stylized birds in profile with prominent beaks and tail feathers pointing upward and outward; the other four are geometric, fan-like or trapezoidal shapes, one of which—at the bottom—features a drawing of a top hat on a platform with rounded objects beside it. The birds and geometric protrusions alternate evenly around the circular center, and the surfaces are decorated with repeating dotted and zigzag patterns.
title: Cut Tin Candleholder
